title: General Intuition’s $2.3B bet that video games can train AI agents for the real world
brief: General Intuition raised $320 million to scale AI agents trained on millions of hours of video gameplay data, aiming to develop AI with human-like intuition for real-world tasks. The company's $2.3B valuation reflects a bet that action-rich game environments can teach AI the embodied reasoning needed for robotics and autonomous systems.
